nodes.name: Keyword.java
nodes.summary: Enum of Java keyword modifiers implementing the Modifier interface (abstract, default, final, native, private, protected, public, static, synchronized, strictfp, transient, volatile).

nodes.name: Modifier.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for Java AST modifiers, implemented by Keyword and TAnnotation.

nodes.name: Null.java
nodes.summary: Singleton class representing the null literal, providing a non-null sentinel for use in collections that don't accept null values.

subNodes.name: Null
subNodes.summary: Singleton wrapper for the null literal value.

subNodes.name: toString
subNodes.summary: Returns the string representation 'NULL'.

nodes.name: PrimitiveType.java
nodes.summary: Java record representing a primitive type with annotations and a BasicType name, implementing TType.

nodes.name: SemiStatement.java
nodes.summary: Represents an empty statement (semicolon) in Java AST with a static factory method mk().

subNodes.name: SemiStatement
subNodes.summary: Empty statement node in Java AST.

subNodes.name: mk
subNodes.summary: Static factory creating a SemiStatement instance.

nodes.name: StTryCaFi.java
nodes.summary: Java record representing a try-catch-finally statement with resources, body, catch clauses, and optional finally block.

subNodes.name: mk
subNodes.summary: Static factory creating an StTryCaFi record instance.

nodes.name: StVar.java
nodes.summary: Java record representing a variable declaration statement with modifiers, type, and declarators.

nodes.name: SuperBound.java
nodes.summary: Java record representing a 'super' type bound in wildcard types (? super T), implementing TypeBound.

nodes.name: SwitchClause.java
nodes.summary: Java record representing a single clause in a switch statement with a label and list of statements.

nodes.name: SwitchLabel.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for switch case labels in Java AST.

nodes.name: TAnnotation.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for type annotations, extending both AnnotationElement and Modifier.

nodes.name: TypeBound.java
nodes.summary: Interface defining a type bound with a method to retrieve the bounding type.

nodes.name: Wildcard.java
nodes.summary: Java record representing a wildcard type (? with optional bound), implementing TType.

nodes.name: TokenKind.java
nodes.summary: Large enum defining all Java language tokens (keywords, operators, literals, separators) with name lookup from a static HashMap.

subNodes.name: Tag
subNodes.summary: Inner enum categorizing tokens: DEFAULT, NAMED, STRING, NUMERIC.

subNodes.name: lookup
subNodes.summary: Static method to look up a TokenKind by its string name, returning IDENTIFIER for unknown names.

nodes.name: InterpreterException.java

subNodes.name: InterpreterException
subNodes.summary: Runtime exception for Rust interpreter errors.

nodes.name: PassthroughException.java
nodes.summary: Package-private exception wrapper for intentional interpreter exceptions thrown for user-facing purposes (not interpreter bugs).

subNodes.name: PassthroughException
subNodes.summary: Runtime exception for intentional user-facing interpreter errors.

nodes.name: Void.java

subNodes.name: Void
subNodes.summary: Sentinel type for interpreter nodes that produce no value.

nodes.name: ArrayType.java

subNodes.name: ArrayType
subNodes.summary: Array type representation for Rust types.

subNodes.name: name
subNodes.summary: Returns the string representation of the array type.

subNodes.name: equals
subNodes.summary: Equality check based on component type.

subNodes.name: hashCode
subNodes.summary: Hash code derived from component type.

nodes.name: BoolType.java
nodes.summary: Singleton type representing the boolean primitive in the Rust type system.

subNodes.name: BoolType
subNodes.summary: Singleton boolean type for Rust.

subNodes.name: isPrimitive
subNodes.summary: Returns true indicating this is a primitive type.

subNodes.name: name
subNodes.summary: Returns the type name 'Bool'.

nodes.name: NullType.java
nodes.summary: Singleton type representing the null type in the Rust type system.

subNodes.name: NullType
subNodes.summary: Singleton null type for Rust.

subNodes.name: name
subNodes.summary: Returns the type name 'Null'.

nodes.name: TypeType.java
nodes.summary: Singleton type representing the type-of-types (meta-type) in the Rust type system.

subNodes.name: TypeType
subNodes.summary: Singleton meta-type for Rust.

subNodes.name: name

nodes.name: VoidType.java
nodes.summary: Singleton type representing the void type in the Rust type system.

subNodes.name: VoidType
subNodes.summary: Singleton void type for Rust.

subNodes.name: name

nodes.name: Chance.java
nodes.summary: Utility class for random number generation with methods for coin flip, bounded random, random selection from arrays, and probability checks.

subNodes.name: Chance
subNodes.summary: Static utility class wrapping java.util.Random for common random operations.

subNodes.name: flip
subNodes.summary: Coin flip returning true/false with 50/50 probability.

subNodes.name: random
subNodes.summary: Returns a random integer in [0, bound).

subNodes.name: random
subNodes.summary: Returns a random integer (possibly negative).

subNodes.name: selectp
subNodes.summary: Selects a random element from an int array.

subNodes.name: selectp
subNodes.summary: Selects a random element from a char array.

subNodes.name: select
subNodes.summary: Selects a random element from a generic varargs array.

subNodes.name: probability
subNodes.summary: Returns true on average 'times' out of 'outof'.

nodes.name: ArrayStack.java
nodes.summary: Stack implementation extending ArrayList with push/pop/peek operations, sublist-based top/from views, and array-backed bulk operations.

subNodes.name: ArrayStack
subNodes.summary: ArrayList-backed stack with push/pop/peek/top/from/truncate operations and array conversion support.

subNodes.name: push
subNodes.summary: Pushes a single item onto the stack.

subNodes.name: push
subNodes.summary: Pushes multiple items onto the stack via varargs.

subNodes.name: push
subNodes.summary: Pushes all elements of a collection onto the stack.

subNodes.name: top
subNodes.summary: Returns a sublist view of the top n elements.

subNodes.name: from
subNodes.summary: Returns a sublist view from an index to the top of the stack.

subNodes.name: pop
subNodes.summary: Removes and returns the top item, throwing if empty.

subNodes.name: pop
subNodes.summary: Removes and returns top n items as an array.

subNodes.name: peek
subNodes.summary: Returns the top item without removing it, throwing if empty.

subNodes.name: snoop
subNodes.summary: Returns the top item or null if empty (non-throwing peek).

subNodes.name: poll
subNodes.summary: Removes and returns the top item, or null if empty.

subNodes.name: clone
subNodes.summary: Returns a clone of the stack via super.clone() with cast.

nodes.name: ThrowingSupplier.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface similar to java.util.function.Supplier but allowed to throw Throwable.
